argv: Matched full-resolution supplied source and reduced candidate, followed by six rejected-procedural comparisons. Source PBR paths/connections/color spaces are repaired for comparison; the original is unchanged. The candidate adds reduced geometry/textures and fin opacity. Temporary opening uses the verified exact reduced QA mesh.
Cost compares the original C1 performance reference against the exported candidate. Supplied-source before images show a separate 16,128-triangle source.
